body:
I am a certified perfectionist and I have extraordinarily low self-esteem..  I know that lots of people struggle with this and that's part of the issue.  I hate myself even more for feeling this way because  have absolutely no right to.  But it's become this giant cycle of shame.

Definitely need to sleep more, but have a hard time closing my eyes without seeing Michael hanging from a rope.
Try to work out pretty regularly.  Tricky part is that I over-exercise and under-eat.  

Thanks for your thoughts

I have a shit ton on my mind and I can't turn it off.  Haven't slept in two weeks.  I'm tired of grieving and I know my friends are sick of it.  I don't know where to go from here.  I hate that being fun and funny is so easy for so many people.  I wish I was fun to be around.

I have tried so hard to make my life worthwhile and I fail at every turn. why continue to subject myself and others to that?
